 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; */ -- Old SQL

 /* -- MLT 4865

 t_where_clause := t_where_clause || ' and unit_id = nvl(' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block_1.unit_id) || ', unit_id)';

 set_block_property('units', DEFAULT_WHERE, t_where_clause);
 go_block('units');

 */

 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_block_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_block_1.coll_date is null

 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; */
 last_record;
 t_rec_count := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 first_record;
 t_coll_date := :units.coll_date;
 for i in 1 .. t_rec_count loop
 if t_coll_date = :units.coll_date then
 begin
 select count(*) 
 into temp_extract
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and extract_date is not null;
 if temp_extract > 0 then
 show_error('0009'); -- 0024
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select count(*) 
 into temp_res
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and result_dats is not null;
 if temp_res > 0 then
 show_error('0024'); -- 0014

 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; 
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.batch_id');
 show_error('0500');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if to_number(:system.cursor_record) < t_rec_count then
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :ctrl_block_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 exception

 then

 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; 
end;

--/* Added MLT 569 batch id linked with morethen one chapter id ,warning message raised * /
DECLARE

 CURSOR cur_batch_id IS
 SELECT
 unit_id
 --get_chapter(unit_id) as multiple_chapter_id
 FROM
 units
 WHERE
 batch_id = :ctrl_block_1.batch_id
 GROUP BY
 unit_id;

 CURSOR check_count (
 ca_unit_id units.unit_id%TYPE
 ) IS
 SELECT
 unit_id,
 chapter_id
 FROM
 units
 WHERE
 chapter_id != :global.chapter_id
 AND unit_id = ca_unit_id;

 v_record_exist CHAR(1) := 'N';
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_block_1.batch_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 lv_text := NULL;
 FOR rec_batch IN cur_batch_id LOOP
 IF v_record_exist = 'Y' THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 FOR rec_count IN check_count(rec_batch.unit_id) LOOP
 IF rec_count.unit_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 lv_text := lv_text
 || ','
 || rec_count.chapter_id;
 v_record_exist := 'Y';
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 
 IF lv_text IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_error('1411', ltrim(lv_text, ','));
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 END IF;

 
 /* lv_chapter_cnt :=null;

 count(*)
 into lv_chapter_cnt
 from units
 where batch_id = :ctrl_block_1.batch_id 
 and chapter_id != :global.chapter_id; 
 
 if lv_chapter_cnt = 1 then
 show_error('1411');
 end if;
 end if; */
 
--/* End MLT 569 batch id linked with morethen one chapter id ,warning message raised * /

 --- message('validation passes');pause;

 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date');
 message('Enter new coll date (DDMONYYYY) - Date cannnot be after original check in.', no_acknowledge); --MLT# 599 
 ELSE

 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_unit_id');
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

DECLARE
 -- MLT 4865 (Modified this routine to allow unit by unit scan)
 ln_Count NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_block_1.unit_id IS NULL THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 IF unit_already_scanned(:CTRL_BLOCK_1.UNIT_ID) THEN
 show_error('9750');
 check_package_failure;
 RETURN;
 END IF; 
 

 
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 COUNT(*)
 INTO ln_Count
 FROM

 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_block_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 IF ln_Count = 0 THEN
 show_error('0210');

 RETURN;
 END IF;

 IF unit_from_diff_contract(:CTRL_BLOCK_1.UNIT_ID) THEN
 show_error('1280');

 RETURN;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 COUNT(*)
 INTO ln_Count
 FROM

 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_block_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND extract_date IS NOT NULL;

 IF ln_Count > 0 THEN
 show_error('0009'); -- 0024
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE

 SELECT
 COUNT(*)
 INTO ln_Count
 FROM
 utrs
 WHERE
 unit_id = :ctrl_block_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND result_dats IS NOT NULL;

 IF ln_Count > 0 THEN
 show_error('0024'); -- 0014
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 ADD_UNIT_RECORD(:CTRL_BLOCK_1.UNIT_ID); 
 
 :ctrl_block_1.s_chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;


 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_local_date DATE := sysdate; -- SCR 18938
 ncount NUMBER := 0;
 lv_status VARCHAR2(2000);
 lv_batch_id VARCHAR2(100);
 p_received_date DATE;
 error_flag varchAR2(1);
 
 
BEGIN

 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 :global.error_count := 'N'; -- This is used in the on-error triger
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 
 IF NVL(:GLOBAL.error_count, 'N') = 'Y' THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 
 IF :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date > v_local_date OR -- SCR 18938 
 :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date = :units.coll_date THEN
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 -- get the received date 
 -- MLT 5867
 
 If :ctrl_block_1.batch_id is not null then 
 begin
 select received_date into p_received_date from batch_inputs where 
 batch_id=:ctrl_block_1.batch_id;
 exception when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 If :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date > p_received_date then 
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 
 
 Else -- IF UNIT ID IS ENTERED 
 
 error_flag:=null;
 GO_BLOCK('units');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 p_received_date:=null;
 BEGIN
 select received_date into p_received_date from UNITS where 
 unit_id=:units.unit_id and rownum=1;
 
 If :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date > p_received_date then 
 error_flag:='Y';
 EXIT;
 End If;
 
 EXCEPTION when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 DOWN;
 END LOOP;
 
 If nvl(error_flag,'N')='Y' then
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date'); 
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 
 End If;
 
 
 -------- 
 
 IF :ctrl_block_1.batch_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- batch id was entered (and all units from the batch are retrieved)
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.confirm_y_n'); -- all the units in teh batch is getting chnaged so no need to create a batch id
 ELSE
 -- user choose to enter/scan unit.
 
 -- SCENARIO 1
 -- If all the units scanned belong to a single batch
 -- All the units in the batch are scanned, treat it as a batch mode processing.
 -- All the units in the batch are not scanned, create a new batch for the scanned units.
 
 -- SCENARIO 2
 -- If the units belong to multiple batches - create a new batch and link all the units to new batch.
 
 SBCLIB.process_tcicoldt_units( units_list_in => GLOBALVAR.gv_units_list,
 chapter_id_in => :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 batch_id_out => lv_batch_id,
 status_out => lv_status);
 
 IF lv_status <> 'OK' THEN
 MESSAGE('Error ' || lv_status);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF lv_batch_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_window('page_5');
 :ctrl_block_1.new_batch_id := lv_batch_id;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.CONFIRM_BATCH_Y_N');
 ELSE
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.confirm_y_n'); -- all the units in teh batch is getting chnaged so no need to create a batch id
 END IF;
 
 
 END IF;
 
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
 ---timer_id TIMER; -- SCR 18044
begin
 If :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 sql_str VARCHAR2(500);
 t_rec_count NUMBER;
 CURSOR c1 IS
 SELECT
 table_name,
 column_name
 FROM
 appl_rep_columns
 WHERE
 application = :banner.prog_name
 AND upper(table_name) NOT IN ( 'CUSTOMER_DBCR_ADJUST', 'WH_TRANS_DTL', 'COMPETANCY_TEST_RESULTS', 'INTERFACE_LOG_EXCP', 'INTERFACE_LOG_PARMS',
 'LABEL_PRINT_LOG', 'PROC_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTE_LOG', 'PROFICIENCY_DATA', 'PT_BATCH_DET', 'RESULT_INP_DTL',
 'SAMPLE_PACK_DET', 'TEMP_TUBES', 'TEMP_UNITS', 'LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL' ); -- This table does not have the "COLL_DATE" field
BEGIN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 IF :confirm_y_n = 'Y' THEN
 :global.first_time := 'Y';
 message('Working...', no_acknowledge);

 GO_BLOCK('units');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO collection_date_changes (
 unit_id,
 coll_date,
 chapter_id,
 old_coll_date,
 insert_dats,
 change_user_id
 ) VALUES (
 :units.unit_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :units.coll_date,
 sysdate,
 :banner.user_id
 );

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('something went wrong...');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 FOR c1rec IN c1 LOOP
 do_updates(upper(c1rec.table_name), upper(c1rec.column_name), :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date, :units.coll_date, :units.unit_id);

 check_package_failure;
 END LOOP; 
 
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 DOWN;
 END LOOP; 

 :system.message_level := 10;
 COMMIT;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 IF NOT form_success THEN
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Transaction Committed. CLEAR SCREEN for new entry.', no_acknowledge);
 refresh_units_block(mode_in => 'BATCH');
 :ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date := NULL;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.batch_id');
 set_control_block('D');
 END IF;

 ELSE
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.new_coll_date');
 END IF;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_UPDATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure do_updates(p_table_name in varchar2,
 p_column_name in varchar2,
 p_new_coll_date in date,
 p_old_coll_date in date,
 p_unit_id in varchar2
 ) is
v_cursorid integer;
v_rowupdate integer;
v_updatestmt varchar2(500);
v_old_coll_date varchar2(15) := to_char(p_old_coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy');
v_new_coll_date varchar2(15) := to_char(p_new_coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy');
TABLE_NOT_EXIST EXCEPTION;
PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(TABLE_NOT_EXIST, -00942);
v_chapter_id varchar2(100);

BEGIN
 
 v_cursorid := DBMS_SQL.OPEN_CURSOR ;
 v_updatestmt := 'UPDATE '||p_table_name||' SET '||p_column_name||
 ' = '||IN_QUOTES(v_new_coll_date)||
 ' WHERE unit_id = '||in_quotes(p_unit_id)||' and '||p_column_name||
 ' = '||in_quotes(v_old_coll_date)||' and chapter_id = '||in_quotes(:global.chapter_id); -- /* Added :global chapter id for MLT 569 collection date update logic*/
 
 --message(v_updatestmt);pause; 
 DBMS_SQL.PARSE(v_cursorid, v_updatestmt, 2);
 v_rowupdate := DBMS_SQL.EXECUTE(v_cursorid);
 DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(v_cursorid);
EXCEPTION
 when TABLE_NOT_EXIST THEN
 Message('Msg: Cannot access database tables - '||p_table_name);pause;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(v_cursorid);
 Message(SQLERRM);pause;
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
END;

procedure gen_batch_id (pl_batch_prefix in varchar2, pl_batch_id out varchar2) is
 local_sys_date date;
BEGIN
 -------
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,local_sys_date);
 else
 local_sys_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 ----------
 select pl_batch_prefix||'-RG'||to_char(nvl(batch_seq,1000)+1)
 into pl_batch_id
 from chapters 
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 for update of batch_seq;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0090');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 BEGIN
 update chapters
 set batch_seq = nvl(batch_seq,1000) + 1
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 END;
EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
END;

 BEGIN

 ------------------

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_UNIT_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE add_unit_record(unit_id_in IN VARCHAR2) IS

BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('units');
 LAST_RECORD;
 IF :UNITS.UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 SELECT contract_id, 
 os_unit_id, 
 unit_id, 
 coll_date, 
 batch_id
 INTO :UNITS.CONTRACT_ID,
 :UNITS.OS_UNIT_ID,
 :UNITS.UNIT_ID,
 :UNITS.COLL_DATE,
 :UNITS.BATCH_ID
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = unit_id_in
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 IF LENGTH(:UNITS.OS_UNIT_ID) = 13 THEN
 validate_unit_chkdigit(:UNITS.OS_UNIT_ID, :UNITS.OS_CHK_DIGIT);
 END IF;
 
 IF LENGTH(:UNITS.UNIT_ID) = 13 THEN
 validate_unit_chkdigit(:UNITS.UNIT_ID, :UNITS.CHK_DIGIT);
 END IF; 
 
 :UNITS.CHECKIN_BATCH_ID := get_batch_id(unit_id_in => :UNITS.UNIT_ID); 

 :UNITS.REC_NO := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD; 
 
 GLOBALVAR.gv_units_contract := :UNITS.CONTRACT_ID; -- Used to make sure that all units being scanned are from same contract.
END;

 DELETE_RECORD;

 END IF;
 
 
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';

ProgramUnit.Name: REMOVE_RECORDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REMOVE_RECORDS(rec_nos_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
 ln_rec_no NUMBER;
BEGIN
 FOR rec IN (
 select TRIM(regexp_substr (
 rec_nos_in,
 '[^,]+',
 1,
 level
 )) rec_no
 from dual
 connect by level <= 
 length ( rec_nos_in ) - length ( replace ( rec_nos_in, ',' ) ) + 1)
 LOOP
 IF rec.rec_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 ln_rec_no := TO_NUMBER(rec.rec_no);
 
 GO_BLOCK('UNITS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF :UNITS.REC_NO = ln_rec_no THEN
 GLOBALVAR.remove_list_item(:UNITS.UNIT_ID);
 DELETE_RECORD;
 END IF;
 
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 
END REMOVE_RECORDS;
